segments.comment: Independent C-first altar-menu route for the real-Amulet low-altar caller: a lawful Knight wishes for a chaotic altar and real Amulet, declines the bonus wish, chooses the MCMD_OFFER item, opens the inventory list, and selects `i`, the C-observed Amulet of Yendor slot. It exercises dosacrifice→offer_too_soon; retain the earlier guessed-slot attempt as a setup miss.
